notes.title: v2.0 - The Rework Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]ITS FINALLY TIME FOR ANOTHER BANE MURRAIN UPDATE![/b]
This is a big one too. Although the levels remain mostly as they were (aside from a completely rebuilt first level + tutorial) [b]the entire rest of the game has had a drastic overhaul[/b], reworking and [b]rebuilding half the game from the ground[/b] up for a more professional and smoother-to-run experience![/p][p][b]NEW GRAPHICS[/b] - The game has been [b]moved from Unity's HDRP to URP[/b] and every texture has been rebalanced to account for this. The game's alot brighter and cartoonish now, which suits the style far more than the fancy shading and [b]should have the game running smoother for alot of people![/b][/p][p]The [b]dialogue sections in the saferoom have also been completely redrawn and reanimated[/b] to have more lively expressions. They move! They talk! Wowie!
[i](Cosmetics have been temporarily disabled but will be re-added later. Animation takes a long time!)[/i]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683840/b61876831f9610649f6671ee07af498698431d84.png"][/img][/p][p][b]NEW PLAYER, NEW MOVEMENT[/b] - Dayne has been rebuilt from the ground up for more momentum and speed-building movement like [b]bunny hopping and rocket jumping[/b], providing some ridiculously quick movement methods for speedrunners while making things smoother for the slow players too![/p][p]The previous movement system used a botched, modified version of Unity's standard FPS asset. With this reworked movement system [b]I can actively tweak Dayne's movement over updates[/b] and make better alterations / bug fixes in a simpler fashion.[/p][p][/p][p][b]OVERDRIVE PUNCH[/b] - The Fervour punch is now far more worth the risk, where [b]gibbing punches cause catastrophic explosions that damage enemies in an entire area.[/b] Alongside this, weak points for punching enemies now have clear markers for hitting, which is [b]all explained in detail within the game's new tutorial level![/b] I wanted to put as much effort as I can into making the game clear and understandable for all audiences, which I'll try to uphold with the later game aspects as best I can.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683840/9dbe5fc3c73c5681f13f4e6359cf6140d2ad3a0c.png"][/img][b]There's a whole bunch of tweaks, changes and expansions to the menu screens, weapons, how the enemies work and a lot more.[/b] You'll just have to play the game to find out!
Or read about them in the changelog below I guess.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]v2.0 Changelog: [/b][/u]"The Rework Update"[/p][p][b][u]MAJOR GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/u][/b][/p][p][b]fancy bits:[/b][/p][p]- The game has been switched from Unity's HDRP to URP Rendering[/p][p]- Rebuilt the entire Main Menu[/p][p]- Also rebuilt the entire Extras menu[/p][p]- All loading screens have been updated with hints and level previews[/p][p]- The HUD layout has been completely altered and redrawn[/p][p]- Hand-drawn font in menus have been swapped for something more clean[/p][p]- The End of Act screen has been completely reworked with individual stats per part[/p][p]- Episode Acts now have ranking scores to achieve[/p][p]- The pause screen has been completely rebuilt, and can be used to access settings now[/p][p][/p][p][b]player rework:[/b][/p][p]- Player movement and physics has been completely rebuilt[/p][p]- The Mouse Wheel can now be used to switch weapons[/p][p]- The game is now playable with a Controller (ish)[/p][p]- Timed bunny hops build player velocity until they stop moving[/p][p]- The camera now shakes in response to weapon fire[/p][p]- Weapons now have a maximum ammo count / limit[/p][p]- Gibbing enemies with a fervour punch creates a fervour explosion[/p][p]- Player now starts levels at a minimum of 50 health[/p][p]- Dayne has been made gayer[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]MINOR GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/u][/b][/p][p][b]item pickups:[/b][/p][p]- Picking up an Overcharge at over 200 health no longer resets health back to 200, and counts as a standard[/p][p]- Picking up weapons you already have plays weapon pickup sound instead of ammo pickup[/p][p]- Weapon pickup sounds are now all randomly pitch shifted[/p][p]- The PULSTN now gives plasma ammo for picking up again rather than lite ammo[/p][p]- You can pick up a chainsaw even if you already have one now[/p][p]- The Lite Ammo Magazine, Plasma Cartridge & Missile pickups are twice as large now[/p][p]- Plasma Cartridges no longer have a spotlight around them[/p][p]- Keycards are larger now and glow vibrantly[/p][p]- Ammount of ammo per pickup has been increased[/p][p]- Essence Orbs are larger[/p][p][/p][p][b]health pickup:[/b][/p][p]- Health pickups now flash with a glowing yellow outline[/p][p]- Large Health pickups now drop can-tab particles[/p][p]- Unique audio added for Large Health pickups + pitch shifting for all[/p][p]- Health vending machines now spawn Health Packs instead of singular cans[/p][p]- Singular Cans now grant +2 Health instead of +1[/p][p][/p][p][b]effects:[/b][/p][p]- New tentacles!! Wow!! So smooth!![/p][p]- Large Gibs are chunkier now and bouncier[/p][p]- Leaves now move like leaves kinda[/p][p]- Petal Saws make sound and create petal explosions when they hit objects[/p][p]- Dayne's face in the HUD wiggles his eyebrows faster[/p][p]- Small chance Gibs will splatter on the screen when close to large gib bursts[/p][p]- Multiple unused Dayne quipps have been re-added and the quipp randomizer has been rebalanced[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]WEAPON CHANGES[/u][/b][/p][p]- The TRCHR37 Pump-Action Shotgun has been redesigned[/p][p]- Added visual changes to all upgraded weapons in workbench[/p][p]- The HRL3 has been rescaled to account for other gun sizes in comparison[/p][p]- New fire sound for Double Barrel TRCHR37[/p][p]- Frostbyte Chainsaw is now visually unique[/p][p]- The DNK50's rocket fire sound is slightly thumpier[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]ENEMY CHANGES[/u][/b][/p][p]- Enemies gain a punch icon when a fervourless punch is available[/p][p]- Destroying frozen enemies now causes small fervour explosions[/p][p]- All enemy projectiles have been slowed for better dodging[/p][p]- All enemy sprites glow slightly for better contrast[/p][p]- First frame of enemy death animations have a randomly shuffled length for variance[/p][p]- Rabid Draugr health has been greatly nerfed[/p][p]- New Death variation for Rabid Draugr when killed with a shotgun[/p][p]- Rabid Draugr have damaged textures for half health[/p][p]- Calviscera can now be stunned with bullets[/p][p]- Calviscera move faster / slower depending on difficulty now (similarly to Draugr)[/p][p]- Claviscera now turns into a melee enemy when both arms are lost[/p][p]- Rodent Mechs now shoot randomly angled projectiles[/p][p]- Rodent Mechs now visually change slightly to show damage progress[/p][p]- Panopticorpse attack sounds are now pitch shifted randomly[/p][p]- BloodWillows drop their horns when they die[/p][p]- Flying Bastards have been reworked with new movement & different bullets[/p][p]- Acid floors now deal reduced damage[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]OPTIMISATION[/u][/b][/p][p]- Enemy corpses have been slimmed down to one object instead of four each[/p][p]- Triggered weak point colliders now destroy themselves after use[/p][p]- Health pickups have been reduced from 3 objects per prefab to 1[/p][p]- Ammo pickups have been reduced from 3 objects per prefab to 1[/p][p]- Keycards have been reduced from 3 objects per prefab to 1[/p][p]- Changed various enemy bullets to use object pooling[/p][p]- Removed volume / post-processing frame upon muzzle flash[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]NEW OPTIONS & MODIFIERS[/u][/b][/p][p]- Dynamic FOV: Player FOV now slightly changes depending on movespeed[/p][p]- Controller Sensitivity for connected gamepads[/p][p]- Game Speed can be changed for slower or faster gameplay[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]CAMPAIGN CHANGES[/u][/b][/p][p][b]misc[/b][/p][p]- End of Act screen now uses Space to continue instead of Enter[/p][p]- Start of Act title cards can now be skipped[/p][p]- Data LOGS reset on a Full Campaign Reset now[/p][p]- Jeff Cole now teleports to the player if he's too far away[/p][p][/p][p][b]tutorial[/b][/p][p]- Rebuilt the entire tutorial again again[/p][p][/p][p][b]the saferoom[/b][/p][p]- Reworked saferoom workbench visuals to use physical space[/p][p]- Workbench HUD uses new font and has buttons for mouse input[/p][p]- Added each weapon's equip sounds to the workbench menu[/p][p]- Added a workbench essence bar/meter to show weapon upgrade progress[/p][p]- Fixed some Dialtone segment spelling mistakes[/p][p]- Completely reworked Dialtone terminal talks to look more like a Visual Novel[/p][p]- Added more button input options for continuing/skipping visual novel segments[/p][p]- Visual Novel dialogue is now stereo'd around the camera depending where the characters stand[/p][p]- Visual Novel segment text is typed out in an animation now[/p][p]- Dialtone Monitor fade transitions back to gameplay when finished with[/p][p]- Added THE RIZZ'O'METER to the Saferoom[/p][p]- Fixed Zeph's Dialtone progression, which has been broken the whole time apparently[/p][p][/p][p][b]episode1 act1[/b][/p][p]- Loading Act One from the menu now boots straight to \[P1] instead of the Title Card[/p][p]- Rebuilt the entire level from the ground up lmfao \[p1][/p][p]- Minor décor placement changes \[p2][/p][p][/p][p][b]episode1 act2[/b][/p][p]- Changed collision mesh for Herold's office table \[p2][/p][p]- Fixed one-off draugr from breaking SMG pooling \[p2][/p][p]- Fans on the ceiling no longer damage entities \[p2][/p][p]- Added extra railings with electricity warning signs \[p3][/p][p]- Increased collider to trigger Dayne lines when moving downstairs \[p3][/p][p]- Endless ammo spawners have been placed in the Evil Dummy room \[p3][/p][p]- The Evil Dummy's health has been halved \[p3][/p][p]- Tweaked and changed various enemy placements throughout the level \[p3][/p][p]- Added FX to Christine's radio com lines \[p3][/p][p][/p][p][b]episode1 act3[/b][/p][p]- Filled the area with tons of ammo \[p1][/p][p]- Added a higher border around the elevator to prevent flying outwards \[p3][/p][p]- Added FX to Christine's radio com lines \[p2][/p][p][/p][p][b]episode1 act4[/b][/p][p]- Stopped the crushing blockades still damaging player once fully closed \[p1][/p][p]- Christine's balcony has been blocked off from the player's reach \[p2][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]HORDE MODE[/u][/b][/p][p]- Original tester room horde map has been removed[/p][p]- Dungeon Mode has been removed[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]COSMETICS[/u][/b][/p][p]- All Outfits have been put under maintenance[/p][p]- HUD Cosmetics are in the process of being reworked / redesigned[/p][p][/p][p]I hope y'all have fun with this update! [b]I'm gonna crack down on making the next few episodes now[/b], I just needed to get everything polished up beforehand so it wasn't this huge, impossible reworking task later on down the line.
This took way longer than expected, but that seems to be a pattern so far lmao.[/p][p]Until next time!
-Elias[/p]

notes.title: v1.1 - Day Not-One Patch
notes.notes:
[b]Hey all![/b]
Thank y'all so much for playing the game so far- there's been way more players than I'd expected to have at first and the support means alot!
I've been reading and keeping up-to-date with all the reviews and community notes as best as I can; [b]If you haven't already left a review on the game, I'd love to hear your thoughts + it helps boost the game on Steam to reach more people.[/b]

I'm starting to chip away at some of the issues and suggestions in the Community Hub and the Discord, and this patch is the first step. I wanted to get this out sooner since it fixes the main menu aspect ratio issues, but alas I've been plagued by other life events... It's here now though!

[b]v1.1 Changelog:[/b]
"Day Not-One Patch"

[b]GENERAL GAME CHANGES[/b]
- Un-fucked the main menu mostly
- Tweaked menu aspect ratio adjusting to scale correctly
- Tweaked 'Made with Unity' Splash screen

[b]SETTINGS AND JUNK[/b]
- Added Invert Y mouse option
- Moved all HUD related settings to it's own submenu under 'Video'
- Added alternate non-dynamic cursor options
- Added a slider to change cursor opacity
- Move Enemy Markers setting to 'Gameplay'
- Option added to stop doors crushing you (for cowards)
- Added 2560 x 1440 Resolution

[b]CAMPAIGN CHANGES[/b]
[i]episode1 act1[/i]
- Bathroom doors can now be closed after opening (softlock fix) [p1]
- Tweaked the colliders / shape of the Exploded Dropship (softlock fix) [p3]

[i]episode1 act2[/i]
- Tweaked some shelving placements (softlock fix) [p3]

I'm currently sorting out some more graphics settings like changing the texture resolution and such for smoother gameplay, but it needs more time in the oven so bear with me a tad bit.
[b]Also expect some more outfits to be added! >:3[/b]

Until then, keep bane'ing y'all.
- Elias

[i]P.S. This update still doesn't effect the Demo yet. Soz![/i]

notes.title: v0.8 - Demo Update

First update! Technically!
I know the demo's just come out but I wanna jump on those bugs and little pieces of advice as soon as I can - If you encounter any bugs, issues or general tweaks that could be made/fixed, join the discord and drop 'em in the chat!
HERE'S THE DISCORD LINK:  https://discord.gg/z6YyaENVcK

Okay, On with the usual bit. Some parts are cut-out since they're out-of-demo changes.

DEMO PATCHING
[i]- Reactivated Main Menu Achievements
- Reactivated Secret get Achievement
- Reactivated Wake Up Achievement
- Reactivated Educated Achievement
- Reactivate Horde Mode Achievements

KNOWN ISSUES

LESS PREVALENT ISSUES

I hope y'all are having fun playing as much as I am making!
Enjoy the Demo!
- Elias
